book.astralenchant.enchanters_guide.ench:
Items with <t>enchantment.astralenchant.affinity<t> can have **any enchantment** applied, ignoring the following restrictions:
- Whether the item type is supported
- Whether the item is enchantable
- Enchantment conflicts

This may not work with enchantment-combining methods added by other mods. If that happens, use [](item://minecraft:anvil) instead.

**[Max Level]**    
1    
**[Anvil Cost]**    
32    
**[Supported Items]**    
Any Item    
**[Slot]**    
any

Applying <t>enchantment.astralenchant.almighty<t> raises the mining tier of the tool — iron at level 1, diamond at level 2, and netherite at level 3 — and at level 4, by default, also allows mining unbreakable blocks such as [](item://minecraft:bedrock).    
<t>enchantment.astralenchant.almighty<t> removes the tool-type restriction and raises the mining tier, but mining speed still depends on the original tier of the tool. For example, a level-4 [](item://minecraft:wooden_hoe) with <t>enchantment.astralenchant.almighty<t> can mine [](item://minecraft:obsidian), but since its speed is still that of a wooden tool, it will take an incredibly long time.

<t>enchantment.astralenchant.curse_of_enchantment<t> prevents the enchantments on the item from being changed.    
        It cannot be changed by combining at [](item://minecraft:anvil), removing at [](item://minecraft:grindstone), switching at [](item://astralenchant:enchanters_workbench), the effect of [<t>enchantment.astralenchant.affinity<t>](entry://enchantment/affinity), or any other means added by other mods.

**[Max Level]**    
1    
**[Anvil Cost]**    
8    
**[Supported Items]**    
Any Item    
**[Slot]**    
any

<t>enchantment.astralenchant.curse_of_ignorance<t> makes the tooltip hard to read. If you squint, you might be able to make out a little...    
By default it also hides the name of the item, which may affect things like the item preview from [EnhancedTooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/enhancedtooltips).

**[Max Level]**    
1    
**[Anvil Cost]**    
8    
**[Supported Items]**    
Any Item    
**[Slot]**    
any

<t>enchantment.astralenchant.curse_of_intangibility<t> completely removes collision between entities and blocks. As a result, **mobs and players without the ability to fly will fall into the void when wearing it.**

<t>enchantment.astralenchant.dexterity<t> prevents movement speed from being reduced while using an item, and even lets you start sprinting while still using one. For example, all slowdown caused by:
- Eating
- Drawing back a [](item://minecraft:bow)
- Using a [](item://minecraft:shield)

is removed entirely.

<t>enchantment.astralenchant.distortion<t> makes missed attacks land. An attack hitbox that did not connect with an entity is redirected to the nearest entity along the line of sight, and by default the allowed angle increases by 7.5° per level.    
If the line of sight is aimed at a block, the attack only registers when that block has no hitbox (such as [](item://minecraft:tall_grass) or [](item://minecraft:cobweb)).

<t>enchantment.astralenchant.endless_appetite<t> raises the maximum Food Level and hidden Saturation Level.    
**Note that any amount beyond the vanilla default cap will not be displayed.**

**[Max Level]**    
3    
**[Anvil Cost]**    
32    
**[Supported Items]**    
enchantable/chest_armor    
**[Slot]**    
chest    
**[Attribute Effects]**   <t>attribute.astralenchant.food_level_cap_multiplier<t>:+0%%+(レベル^2)*100%%
   <t>attribute.astralenchant.saturation_level_cap_multiplier<t>:+0%%+(レベル^2)*100%%

<t>enchantment.astralenchant.essence_of_enchantment<t> increases **all stats** based on the total level of all the enchantments on the item **except itself** (by default, excluding levels added by [<t>enchantment.astralenchant.overload<t>](entry://enchantment/overload)).    
By default, this grants 1%% per level using **ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE**.    
Neutral attributes such as size and gravity are unaffected, while harmful attributes such as burn duration are decreased.    
It also works on Curios items.

**[Max Level]**    
5    
**[Anvil Cost]**    
32    
**[Supported Items]**    
Any Item    
**[Slot]**    
any

*<t>enchantment.astralenchant.expanse<t> is a [Curios](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios) integration feature, and **is disabled if Curios is not installed!***    
<t>enchantment.astralenchant.expanse<t> only affects Curios items, increasing the number of Curio slots the item occupies. By default, this effect does not stack.

**[Max Level]**    
2    
**[Anvil Cost]**    
16    
**[Supported Items]**    
Any Item    
**[Slot]**    
any

<t>enchantment.astralenchant.feather_touch<t> is a complete upgrade over Silk Touch — in addition to blocks like [](item://minecraft:glass), you can now also collect blocks like [](item://minecraft:budding_amethyst) and [](item://minecraft:reinforced_deepslate).    
If the target is a **block entity** (such as a chest or furnace), it can be turned into an item while preserving its contents. This produces [#](fc842d)orange particles[#]().    
Additionally, while sneaking, it also preserves the **block state** (such as orientation or whether the block is waterlogged). This produces [#](17adad)blue particles[#]().

Applying <t>enchantment.astralenchant.last_stand<t> to armor lets you consume experience points to cancel death.    
The amount of experience consumed scales with **the total level of all worn armor**. Using the *current level* (N) and *enchantment level* (L) along with the *base cost* (B), *rate* (R), and *maximum* (M) values configurable in the settings, the cost consumed is calculated as    
min(M,N\*R/√L+B/L)    
By default, this also cancels death from damage that bypasses invulnerability, such as /kill.

Defeating certain enemies with a weapon enchanted with <t>enchantment.astralenchant.mystic_remnants<t> has a random chance of granting special drops.
- Witch: [](item://minecraft:nether_wart)
- Wither: [](item://minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull)
- Warden: [](item://minecraft:echo_shard)
- Bogged: [](item://astralenchant:rotten_bone)
- Allay: [](item://astralenchant:allay_wing)
- Vex: [](item://astralenchant:vex_wing)

The chance is (level\*5)%%, and the number of rolls differs for each.

By applying <t>enchantment.astralenchant.nullification<t>, attacks bypass the following forms of damage reduction and negation:
- Armor points and armor toughness
- Invulnerability frames
- Effects
- Enchantments
- Invulnerable state
- Shields

The penetration of <t>enchantment.astralenchant.nullification<t> is equivalent to */kill*. As a result, it has no effect on mobs that are resistant to */kill*.    
Attacking with a weapon enchanted with <t>enchantment.astralenchant.nullification<t> produces white particles.

<t>enchantment.astralenchant.overload<t> raises the level of every enchantment on the item **other than itself**, by an amount equal to **its own level**.    
By default, the levels it adds are not included in the total level of [<t>enchantment.astralenchant.essence_of_enchantment<t>](entry://enchantment/essence_of_enchantment).    
In the tooltip, it shines in rainbow colors, making its presence known.

**[Max Level]**    
5    
**[Anvil Cost]**    
32    
**[Supported Items]**    
Any Item    
**[Slot]**    
any

While wearing armor enchanted with <t>enchantment.astralenchant.reactive_armor<t>, the **armor-piercing effects** (such as void damage) and **enchantment-piercing effects** (such as the sonic boom of the Warden) of incoming attacks are negated, allowing that damage to be mitigated by armor.    
Note that the piercing effect from [<t>enchantment.astralenchant.nullification<t>](entry://enchantment/nullification) cannot be negated.

While <t>enchantment.astralenchant.resilience<t> is applied, the cooldown duration of all items is reduced.    
In vanilla, only [](item://minecraft:ender_pearl), [](item://minecraft:chorus_fruit), [](item://minecraft:wind_charge), and [](item://minecraft:shield) benefit from this, but it also affects modded items.

**[Max Level]**    
3    
**[Anvil Cost]**    
16    
**[Supported Items]**    
enchantable/chest_armor    
**[Slot]**    
chest    
**[Attribute Effects]**   <t>attribute.astralenchant.cooldown_duration<t>:-10%%+(-10%%)\*レベル
book.astralenchant.enchanters_guide.name: Enchanter's Guide
book.astralenchant.enchanters_guide.prog:
Oh no. Did you really have to kill an innocent Allay, of all things? It flew for you, gathered your dropped items, and worked without a single complaint.    
Looking at the wing in your hand now, can you honestly say your chest does not ache at all? Tonight, as you lie in bed staring at the ceiling, you might find yourself wondering, did I really have to kill it...?    
What was going through its mind in its final moment? Maybe, did I make the master angry? Or maybe, help me, master!    
Of course, there is no way to know now. You are the one who killed it. That wing is exactly the result of your choice. Congratulations.
Rarely dropped when defeating <t>entity.minecraft.allay<t> with a weapon enchanted with <t>[enchantment.astralenchant.mystic_remnants](entry://enchantment/mystic_remnants)<t>.
allay wing

A material born by possessing plain [](item://minecraft:quartz) and [](item://minecraft:amethyst_shard) with [](item://astralenchant:enchantment_shard), the crystallized remains of burned-out knowledge.    
This faintly glowing crystal is the fruit of the pursuit of knowledge by the ancient enchanters. Whoever handles it must never forget its weight and value.
arcane quartz

A high-purity powder made by gathering and refining [](item://astralenchant:arcane_quartz_tiny_dust).    
It has lost its crystalline form, but thanks to its enormous surface area, it is even more reactive than the crystal itself.
arcane quartz dust
**Can also be obtained by crushing [](item://astralenchant:grown_arcane_quartz) with [](item://minecraft:anvil).**

A fine purple powder obtained by crushing [](item://astralenchant:arcane_quartz) into tiny pieces.    
Each grain gives off a faint glow. Though not a trace of its original form remains, the wisdom within it has never been lost.
arcane quartz tiny dust
**Can also be obtained by crushing [](item://astralenchant:arcane_quartz) with [](item://minecraft:anvil).**

A soft, pale purple alloy made by kneading [](item://astralenchant:arcane_quartz_tiny_dust) into [](item://minecraft:iron_ingot) and [](item://minecraft:gold_nugget).    
It does not look much different from ordinary metal, but its excellent conductivity makes it an ideal seedbed for crystal growth.
arcanium ingot
Can be harvested with a tool that has <t>[enchantment.astralenchant.feather_touch](entry://enchantment/feather_touch)<t> applied.
budding amethyst
Can also be obtained by crafting it from [](item://astralenchant:allay_wing).

[](item://astralenchant:arcane_quartz), quietly continuing to grow while feeding on [](item://astralenchant:arcanium_ingot) as nourishment. Its outward appearance shows little change, but inside, alloy and crystal are steadily merging and growing.
budding arcanium ingot

At <t>block.astralenchant.enchanters_workbench<t>, you can consume [](item://astralenchant:luminite) to switch the items existing enchantments.    
Even enchantments that conflict with each other can coexist by disabling one of them, letting you switch between them depending on your needs.    
If <t>{2}<t> is applied, the above restriction can be ignored.    
Note that curse enchantments cannot be switched.
enchanters workbench

Even when a book is burned to nothing, the knowledge within it does not vanish. The paper turns to ash and the letters disappear, but the wisdom at its core is only refined by the flame, transformed into a pure shard.
enchantment shard
Can be made by smelting any [](item://minecraft:enchanted_book) in a [](item://minecraft:furnace) or [](item://minecraft:blast_furnace).

A tome that, by abandoning the purpose of storing information, has become more compatible with enchantments than a [](item://minecraft:book).
By using various materials as catalysts, it can draw in specific kinds of enchantments.
enchantment vessel

[](item://astralenchant:arcane_quartz) that has fully grown, using a potion as a catalyst to completely absorb [](item://astralenchant:arcanium_ingot).
Its cool touch and heavy weight speak to its rarity.
grown arcane quartz

Can be brewed by adding [item.minecraft.potion.effect.regeneration](item://minecraft:potion[potion_contents={potion:"long_regeneration"}]), [item.minecraft.potion.effect.healing](item://minecraft:potion[potion_contents={potion:"strong_healing"}]), [item.minecraft.potion.effect.fire_resistance](item://minecraft:potion[potion_contents={potion:"long_fire_resistance"}]), and [item.minecraft.potion.effect.strength](item://minecraft:potion[potion_contents={potion:"strong_strength"}]) in order to [](item://astralenchant:budding_arcanium_ingot).
A thing made by smearing [](item://minecraft:magma_cream) all over [](item://astralenchant:arcane_quartz). Surely this must count as heat-resistant treatment!
lavaproof arcane quartz

A crystal with a beautiful gradient, formed by treating [](item://astralenchant:lavaproof_arcane_quartz) with lava.
Intense heat has altered its crystal structure, and with the right handling, energy could likely be drawn out from within.
luminite
